description: Intended gateway verify_jwt contract for every Norfold Edge Function, derived from primary evidence in this repo (function source, its callers, and the deploy command that ships it). Read by scripts/check-edge-parity.mjs --strict; a deployed verify_jwt that disagrees is a failure there.
whyNotSupabaseConfigToml: A supabase/config.toml would imply CLI-managed deploy configuration; this repo deploys through .github/workflows/backend-deploy.yml and scripts/deploy-required-edge-functions.mjs, so an expectations manifest beside the checker carries the contract without claiming a config source of truth the deploy path does not read.

evidenceClasses.source-auth: the function's own index.ts/handler: which auth mode its wrapper enforces, and its explicit deploy note
evidenceClasses.caller: src/apps code, CI workflow, pg_cron/pg_net SQL, or docs that invoke the function and show which credentials it sends
evidenceClasses.deploy: the command line (or deploy-set entry) that publishes the function, including --no-verify-jwt
evidenceClasses.live: read-only observation of the deployed function's verify_jwt via the Supabase management API

evidence.detail: "Deploy with --no-verify-jwt; the wrapper verifies the caller's user JWT." The handler uses withSupabase({ auth: "user" }) and rejects a missing ctx.userClaims.id with 401.
calls fetchSupabaseFunction("chat-media", ...), which sends `Authorization: Bearer <user jwt>` plus the anon apikey; the user JWT is checked by the function body, not the gateway.
supabase functions deploy chat-media --no-verify-jwt --yes
"Deploy with --no-verify-jwt; the wrapper verifies the caller's user JWT."
withSupabase({ auth: "user" }) and an explicit authority note: "the caller must present their own session JWT (deployed with `--no-verify-jwt`; the wrapper verifies it ...)".
fetchSupabaseFunction("chat-wake", accountId, ...) sends the caller's Bearer session token; the wrapper validates it.
supabase functions deploy chat-wake --no-verify-jwt --yes

"Deploy with --no-verify-jwt: the canonical wrapper verifies the server secret API key. No anonymous/public/user route is permitted to sweep private media." Handler uses withSupabase({ auth: "secret" }).
curl POST /functions/v1/cleanup-chat-media with only `-H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY}"` (no Authorization header).
pg_cron net.http_post to /functions/v1/cleanup-chat-media with headers jsonb_build_object('apikey', <vault chat_media_worker_secret>) - no user JWT exists in that path.
supabase functions deploy cleanup-chat-media --no-verify-jwt --yes

curl POST /functions/v1/cleanup-comment-media with only `-H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY}"`.
supabase functions deploy cleanup-comment-media --no-verify-jwt --yes

"Deploy with --no-verify-jwt: the canonical wrapper verifies the server secret API key. No anonymous/public/user route is permitted to claim evidence work." Handler uses withSupabase({ auth: "secret" }).
curl POST /functions/v1/copy-chat-evidence with only the secret `apikey` header.
pg_cron net.http_post to /functions/v1/copy-chat-evidence with only the vault-held apikey header.
supabase functions deploy copy-chat-evidence --no-verify-jwt --yes
"The caller presents their own session JWT (`Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`); the function resolves the uid from that JWT via `auth.getUser()` and deletes ONLY that uid."
client.functions.invoke("delete-account", { method: "POST", headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}` } }) - a real end-user JWT, not an anon key.

REQUIRED_FUNCTIONS entry { name: "delete-account", verifyJwt: true } - deployArgs() omits --no-verify-jwt, so the gateway verifies the JWT and the function verifies it again via getUser(). The deploy-set comment records "JWT verify ON (no flag; gateway-enforced AND ...)".
withSupabase({ auth: "user" }); rejects when ctx.userClaims?.id or ctx.jwtClaims?.session_id is absent (401), so the wrapper - not the gateway - owns identity.
fetchSupabaseFunction("device-enroll", scope.accountId, ...) sends the caller's Bearer session token for the wrapper to verify.
supabase functions deploy device-enroll --no-verify-jwt --yes

"Invocation is server-to-server only: callers present `x-findback-dispatch-secret` matching the `PUSH_DISPATCH_SECRET` function secret." The fetch handler gates on isAuthorized(req.headers.get("x-findback-dispatch-secret"), secret).
